 16 Holiday Gifts for 2026 
 All from Columbia alumni. 
 By 
 Julia Joy 
 | 
 Nov. 17, 2026
 For the celestially curious  
 Lost in Space: 5,000 Facts for Navigating the Universe , by Neil deGrasse Tyson ’92GSAS and Lindsey Nyx Walker: $40 
 For the modern cowgirl 
 Western fashion from Cindy Jane Boutique, founded by Crystal Manke ’14CC. Sonora taupe faux suede western embroidered cowboy boots : $59.99 
 For the person who lives for sweater weather 
 Cozy outerwear from Dudley Stephens, cofounded by Kaki McGrath ’07CC. Bleecker fleece pullover : $168  
 For the person who wants a glow up 
 Korean cosmetics made from upcycled superfoods from Byroe, founded by Amy Roe ’19BUS. “ Sculpt and Smooth ” gift set featuring tomato firming serum and truffle eye serum: $105 
 For that sweet-toothed someone  
 Fine chocolates and custom treats from ChocolaChi, founded by Nadja Soares de Andrade ’11GSAS. Twelve-piece box : $38 
 For the natural oenophile 
 Organic Tuscan wine from Salcheto, board member Ron E. Prashker ’04BUS. 2017 Salco Vido Vino Nobile di Montepulciano : $69.99 
 For the skincare aware  
 “Clean” men’s skincare from Iris & Cole, cofounded by Caroline Finch ’01BUS and Glenn Gomes-Casseres ’01BUS. “All You Need” bundle of hydrating FIXR restorative balm and anti-aging ELXR serum: $124 
 For the person in need of some holiday spirit 
 Craft spirits from Hard Truth Distilling Company, cofounded by Edward Ryan ’97BUS. Sweet mash bourbon : $45.99 
 For the woman with a lot to carry 
 Handbags from Couleurs, founded by Menen Hailu ’08GSAS. “Cruelty free” leather tote : $251 
 For the twee decorator 
 Art prints and greeting cards from Reset Reality, founded by Vanessa Lee ’23SPS. Barn owl print : $7–$35 
 For the cat person 
 Curated cat products from For Paws Collective, cofounded by Elisa Trendelenburg ’17BUS. “Cozy Bowl” capsule scratcher and lounger: $46 
 For the crunchy friend  
 Crunch bars, seeds, and dried fruit from South 40 Snacks, founded by Josh Schroeter ’91JRN, ’99BUS. Variety twelve-pack : $33.99 
 For the person concerned about microplastics 
 Eco-friendly laundry products from Generation Conscious, cofounded by Matthew Rosenbaum ’22BUS. Plastic-free, liquid-free detergent sheets : $29.99 for 100 sheets 
 For the lip-care enthusiast 
 Hydrating Vitamin D lip tint from Aralea Beauty, founded by Christina Louey ’04SIPA: $26 
 For the all-American man  
 American-made menswear from Pool House New York, founded by Andrew Anabi ’18LAW. Newport crop button-up shirt in heavyweight linen: $230 
 For the person who could use some moisture in winter 
 Dermatologist-developed skincare products from Curology, cofounded by Glenn Lortscher ’09LAW. Cream moisturizer : $17
